Section 7.04 Successors and Assigns. This Mortgage shall be binding upon and inure
to the benefit of Mortgagee and Mortgagor and their respective successors and assigns.
Mortgagor shall not, without the prior written consent of Mortgagee, assign any rights, duties or
obligations hereunder, provided, however, the engagement of a property manager in accordance
with Section 8.3 of the Loan Agreement shall not be deemed an assignment for the purposes
hereof.
Section 7.05 No Waiver. Any failure by Mortgagee to insist upon strict performance
of any of the terms, provisions or conditions of the Loan Documents shall not be deemed to be a
waiver of same, and Mortgagee shall have the right at any time to insist upon strict performance
of all of such terms, provisions and conditions.
Section 7.06 Subrogation. To the extent proceeds of the Note have been used to
extinguish, extend or renew any indebtedness against the Mortgaged Property, then Mortgagee
shall be subrogated to all of the rights, liens and interests existing against the Mortgaged
Property and held by the holder of such indebtedness and such former rights, liens and interests,
if any, are not waived, but are continued in full force and effect in favor of Mortgagee as
provided in the Loan Agreement, except with respect to prior defaults by Borrower under such
existing indebtedness, all of which defaults that occurred prior to Mortgagee's interest in the
Mortgaged Property under this Mortgage Mortgagee hereby acknowledges are waived; provided,
however, this waiver shall not operate with respect to any Events of Defaults or other rights of
Mortgagee under this Mortgage or any other Loan Documents.
Section 7.07 Loan Agreement. If any conflict or inconsistency exists between this
Mortgage and the Loan Agreement, the Loan Agreement shall govern.
Section 7.08 Release. Upon payment in full of the Indebtedness and performance in
full of the Obligations, Mortgagee, at Mortgagor's expense, shall release the liens and security
interests created by this Mortgage; provided, however, that in lieu of such release, at
Mortgagor's request, Mortgagee shall assign the Note and this Mortgage, without representation
or recourse, to an institutional lender designated by Mortgagor. In the event that any instruments
to be assigned to the Mortgagor's new lender are lost or misplaced, Mortgagee agrees to provide,
at Mortgagor's expense, a customary lost instrument affidavit to Mortgagee's new lender. In
addition, Mortgagee shall endeavor, at Mortgagor's expense, to reasonably cooperate with
